sn16.11:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā mahākassapo rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
sn16.11:1.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā ānando dakkhiṇāgirismiṃ cārikaṃ carati mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ.
sn16.11:2.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmato ānandassa tiṃsamattā saddhivihārino bhikkhū sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattā bhavanti yebhuyyena kumārabhūtā.
sn16.11:2.2: atha kho āyasmā ānando dakkhiṇāgirismiṃ yathābhirantaṃ cārikaṃ caritvā yena rājagahaṃ veḷuvanaṃ kalandakanivāpo, yenāyasmā mahākassapo tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ mahākassapaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āyasmā mahākassapo etadavoca:
sn16.11:2.3: “kati nu kho āvuso ānanda atthavase paṭicca bhagavatā kulesu tikabhojanaṃ paññattanti?”
sn16.11:3.1: tayo kho bhante kassapa, atthavase paṭicca bhagavatā kulesu tikabhojanaṃ paññattaṃ:
sn16.11:3.2: dummaṅkūnaṃ puggalānaṃ niggahāya, pesalānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ phāsuvihārāya, mā pāpicchā pakkhaṃ nissāya saṅghaṃ bhindeyyuṃ, kulānuddayatāya ca.
sn16.11:3.3: ime kho bhante kassapa, tayo atthavase paṭicca bhagavatā kulesu tikabhojanaṃ paññattanti.
sn16.11:4.1: atha kiñcarahi tvaṃ āvuso ānanda imehi navehi bhikkhūhi indriyesu aguttadvārehi bhojane amattaññūhi jāgariyaṃ ananuyuttehi saddhiṃ cārikaṃ carasi?
sn16.11:4.2: sassaghātaṃ maññe carasi. kulūpaghātaṃ maññe carasi.
sn16.11:4.3: olujjati kho te āvuso ānanda, parisā
sn16.11:5.1: “api me bhante, kassapa, sirasmiṃ palitāni jātāni.
sn16.11:5.2: atha ca pana mayaṃ ajjāpi āyasmato mahākassapassa kumārakavādā na muccāmā”ti.
sn16.11:5.3: tathā hi pana tvaṃ āvuso ānanda, imehi navehi bhikkhūhi indriyesu aguttadvārehi bhojane amattaññūhi jāgariyaṃ ananuyuttehi saddhiṃ cārikaṃ carasi, sassaghātaṃ maññe carasi, kulūpaghātaṃ maññe carasi.
sn16.11:5.4: olujjati kho te āvuso ānanda, parisā.
sn16.11:6.2: “ayyena kira mahākassapena ayyo ānando vedehamuni kumārakavādena apasādito”ti.
sn16.11:7.1: atha kho thullanandā bhikkhunī anattamanā anattamanavācaṃ nicchāresi.
sn16.11:7.2: “kiṃ pana ayyo mahākassapo aññatitthiyapubbo samāno ayyaṃ ānandaṃ vedehamuniṃ kumārakavādena apasādetabbaṃ maññatī”ti.
sn16.11:7.3: assosi kho āyasmā mahākassapo thullanandāya bhikkhuniyā imaṃ vācaṃ bhāsamānāya.
sn16.11:8.1: atha kho āyasmā mahākassapo āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca:
sn16.11:8.2: tagghāvuso ānanda, thullanandāya bhikkhuniyā sahasā appaṭisaṅkhā vācā bhāsitā.
sn16.11:8.3: yatohaṃ āvuso kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito, nābhijānāmi aññaṃ satthāraṃ uddisituṃ aññatra tena bhagavatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena.
sn16.11:8.4: pubbe me āvuso agārikabhūtassa sato etadahosi.
sn16.11:8.6: nayidaṃ sukaraṃ agāraṃ ajjhāvasatā ekantaparipuṇṇaṃ ekantaparisuddhaṃ saṅkhalikhitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carituṃ,
sn16.11:8.7: yannūnāhaṃ kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajeyya”nti.
sn16.11:8.8: so kho ahaṃ āvuso aparena samayena paṭapilotikānaṃ saṅghāṭiṃ karitvā ye loke arahanto te uddissa kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajiṃ.
sn16.11:9.1: so evaṃ pabbajito samāno addhānamaggapaṭipanno addasaṃ bhagavantaṃ antarā ca rājagahaṃ antarā ca nālandaṃ bahuputte cetiye nisinnaṃ.
sn16.11:9.7: so khohaṃ āvuso tattheva bhagavato pādesu sirasā nipatitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn16.11:9.10: evaṃ vutte maṃ āvuso, bhagavā etadavoca:
sn16.11:9.11: “yo kho kassapa evaṃ sabbacetasā samannāgataṃ sāvakaṃ ājānaññeva vadeyya jānāmīti, apassaññeva vadeyya passāmīti, muddhāpi tassa vipateyya.
sn16.11:9.12: ahaṃ kho pana kassapa jānaññeva vadāmi jānāmīti, passaññeva vadāmi passāmī”ti.
sn16.11:10.2: “tibbaṃ me hirottappaṃ paccupaṭṭhitaṃ bhavissati theresu navesu majjhimesū”ti.
sn16.11:11.2: “yaṃ kiñci dhammaṃ suṇissāmi. kusalūpasaṃhitaṃ, sabbaṃ taṃ aṭṭhikatvā manasikatvā sabbacetasā samannāharitvā ohitasoto dhammaṃ suṇissāmī”ti.
sn16.11:13.1: atha kho maṃ āvuso, bhagavā iminā ovādena ovaditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi.
sn16.11:13.2: sattāhameva kho ahaṃ āvuso sāṇo raṭṭhapiṇḍaṃ bhuñjiṃ. atha aṭṭhamiyā aññā udapādi.
sn16.11:14.1: atha kho āvuso, bhagavā maggā okkamma yenaññataraṃ rukkhamūlaṃ tenupasaṅkami.
sn16.11:14.2: atha khohaṃ āvuso paṭapilotīnaṃ saṅghāṭiṃ catugguṇaṃ paññāpetvā bhagavantaṃ etadavocaṃ:
sn16.11:14.3: “idha bhante, bhagavā nisīdatu, yaṃ mamassa dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyā”ti.
sn16.11:14.4: nisīdi kho āvuso bhagavā paññatte āsane.
sn16.11:14.5: nisajja kho maṃ āvuso bhagavā etadavoca:
sn16.11:14.7: patigaṇhātu me bhante bhagavā paṭapilotīnaṃ saṅghāṭi, anukampaṃ upādāyāti.
sn16.11:14.8: dhāressasi pana me tvaṃ kassapa sāṇāni paṃsukūlāni nibbasanānīti?
sn16.11:14.9: dhāressāmahaṃ bhante bhagavato sāṇāni paṃsukūlāni nibbasanānīti.
sn16.11:14.10: so kho ahaṃ āvuso paṭapilotīnaṃ saṅghāṭiṃ bhagavato pādāsiṃ.
sn16.11:14.11: ahaṃ pana bhagavato sāṇāni paṃsukūlāni nibbasanāni paṭipajjiṃ.
sn16.11:15.1: yaṃ hi taṃ āvuso sammā vadamāno vadeyya
sn16.11:15.2: “bhagavato putto oraso mukhato jāto dhammajo dhammanimmito dhammadāyādo paṭiggahetā. sāṇāni paṃsukūlāni nibbasanānī”ti, mamaṃ taṃ sammā vadamāno vadeyya
sn16.11:15.3: “bhagavato putto oraso mukhato jāto dhammajo dhammanimmito dhammadāyādo paṭiggahetā sāṇāni paṃsukūlāni nibbasanānī”ti.
sn16.11:16.1: ahaṃ kho āvuso yāvade ākaṅkhāmi vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja vihārāmi.
sn16.11:16.3: (navannaṃ anupubba vihārasamāpattīnaṃ pañcannañca abhiññānaṃ evaṃ vitthāro veditabbo.)
sn16.11:17.1: ahaṃ kho āvuso āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharāmi.
sn16.11:17.2: sattaratanaṃ vā so āvuso nāgaṃ aḍḍhaṭṭharatanaṃ vā tālapattikāya chādetabbaṃ maññeyya, yo me abhiññā chādetabbaṃ maññeyyāti.
sn16.11:18.1: cavittha ca pana thullanandā bhikkhunī brahmacariyamhāti.
